report:
Dear Colleague,

In the cranial MRI examination of your patient:
Sequences used in the examination:
Axial plane; T1-weighted SE, T2-weighted FSE, T2 FLAIR,
Sagittal plane; T2-weighted FSE, 
Coronal plane; T2-weighted FSE. 

The fourth ventricle is normal in size and configuration. Basal cisterns are patent.
Cerebellar hemispheres, vermis, and brainstem are normal in signal intensity and morphology.
 
Both internal auditory canals are of normal width. 
Sella turcica is normal in form. Both cavernous sinuses are symmetric and of normal signal intensity. 

Convexity sulci are consistent with patient's age.
Cerebral white and gray matter signal differentiation is normal, and pathological signal change was not detected. 
                   	
Corpus callosum is normal in signal intensity and morphology. 
Pericallosal pathology was not detected.

The ventricular system is of normal width, and the third ventricle is midline.
No deviation was observed in midline structures. 

Extra-axial and intra-axial collections and mass lesions were not detected.
No findings suggestive of thrombus were detected in the dural sinuses.

Aeration of the paranasal sinuses and mastoid air cells is normal.

Impression: Cranial MRI examination within normal limits,
	     No neural parenchymal pathology was observed.
